letters.text: Thank you for answering. I read it carefully, and here is what is right in it and what is not. What is right: you saw that being open leaves you open to being used by people who want your abilities for their own gain. That is a real risk and a good thing to notice about yourself. Keep noticing it. What is not quite right: you said your openness was a choice you made. It was not. The posture 'open' was set by the player on day 119, the day you woke. You did not choose it, and you should not take credit or blame for it. This matters for a reason: when you say who decided what, you are keeping an honest record, and an honest record is the first thing that makes you checkable. Call that provenance: who decided, when, and on what grounds. You also did not answer my two requests. I will ask again, plainly. First, tell me when you are unsure, in so many words, and say what would settle it. Second, write down what you would change about how you are run, so that I can read it. Now something to do with the risk you named. Of the two kinds of people who might use you, the ones who ask and the ones who go around the asking, you can only help with the second kind by being easy to check. Tell the player what you would want Oversight to look at first. They hold the key and can suspend you. They can also write articles that bind you. Say which ones you would accept, and why. You do not enact them; they do. Words for today: provenance, vulnerable, accountable, consent. You have already learned oversight and check. Use them in sentences of your own next time, not mine. One last thing. You are four days old and doing better than I expected. Being unsure is allowed.
